scenes.name_ja: ReplicaCADのオープンプランのアパート
scenes.description: A single open-plan apartment with a kitchen counter, fridge, cupboard, chest of drawers, sliding cabinet, entry door, dining area, and living area.

evidence.source_name: Task Atlas ReplicaCAD task proposals, round 1

external_objects.name_ja: ReplicaCAD 引き戸式サイドボード
external_objects.notes: ReplicaCAD articulated asset cabinet (cabinet.urdf; a cabinet_dynamic.urdf variant also ships). Joints: prismatic left_slide (limits 0 to 0.8 m) and right_slide (limits -0.76 to 0 m); both doors are closed at 0, so right_slide opens toward negative travel. Masses: body 25 kg, each door 2 kg. Receptacles from cabinet.ao_config.json: receptacle_aabb_interiorfrl_apartment_cabinet and receptacle_aabb_topfrl_apartment_cabinet. The cabinet is placed in all 90 non-empty scene instances, but its position changes between layouts (dining area in apt_0). ReplicaCAD has no WordNet synsets, so source_taxonomy repeats the asset category as both category_id and synset_id. Joint limit stands in for closed; no latch, seal, or friction detent is modelled. The Atlas concept link is a curator grouping only, and the simulator asset does not establish physical product behaviour or compatibility with a robot setup.

external_objects.canonical_name: wall of kitchen cupboards with four solid and four glass-window doors
external_objects.name_ja: ReplicaCAD キッチン吊り戸棚 kitchenCupboard_01（木扉とガラス窓扉）
external_objects.notes: ReplicaCAD articulated asset kitchenCupboard_01. Joints: eight revolute hinges doorWhole_1L/1R/2L/2R_hinge (solid doors) and doorWindow_1L/1R/2L/2R_hinge (glass-window doors); L hinges range -2.3 to 0 rad and R hinges 0 to 2.3 rad, all closed at 0. Masses: body 70 kg, each door 8 kg. Twelve shelf receptacles in kitchenCupboard_01.ao_config.json: shelf_left_*, shelf_center_*_left, shelf_center_*_right, and shelf_right_* at bottom, middle, and top heights. Door-to-column mapping is inferred from hinge positions in the URDF body frame: doorWindow_1L/1R span the shelf_left_* column, doorWhole_1L/1R the shelf_center_*_left column, doorWhole_2L/2R the shelf_center_*_right column, and doorWindow_2L/2R the shelf_right_* column; this is an inference to confirm in the simulator, and body-frame left/right need not match a viewer's left/right. Placed in all 90 non-empty scene instances along the kitchen wall. ReplicaCAD has no WordNet synsets, so source_taxonomy repeats the asset category as both category_id and synset_id. Joint limit stands in for closed; no latch, seal, or friction detent is modelled. The Atlas concept link is a curator grouping only, and the simulator asset does not establish physical product behaviour or compatibility with a robot setup.

external_objects.canonical_name: kitchen counter with seven drawers and a sink
external_objects.name_ja: ReplicaCAD キッチンカウンター（引き出し7段とシンク）
external_objects.notes: ReplicaCAD articulated asset kitchen_counter. Joints: seven prismatic slides, each with limits 0 to 0.5 m and closed at 0: left_slide_top (link drawer1_top), left_slide_bottom (drawer1_bottom), middle_slide_top (drawer2_top), middle_slide_middle (drawer2_middle), middle_slide_bottom (drawer2_bottom), right_slide_top (drawer3), right_slide_bottom (drawer4). Masses: body 120 kg; drawers 4 to 6 kg. Receptacles from kitchen_counter.ao_config.json: counter_left, counter_right, sink, and one receptacle_aabb_drawer_*_frl_apartment_kitchen_counter per drawer. Placed in all 90 non-empty scene instances. ReplicaCAD has no WordNet synsets, so source_taxonomy repeats the asset category as both category_id and synset_id. Joint limit stands in for closed; no latch, seal, or friction detent is modelled. The Atlas concept link is a curator grouping only, and the simulator asset does not establish physical product behaviour or compatibility with a robot setup. The sink has no water or tap state.

external_objects.canonical_name: two-door refrigerator with upper and lower compartments
external_objects.notes: ReplicaCAD articulated asset fridge (fridge.urdf; a fridge_dynamic.urdf variant also ships). Joints: revolute top_door_hinge (0 to 2.3 rad) and bottom_door_hinge (0 to 2.5 rad), both closed at 0. Masses: body 70 kg, top door 8 kg, bottom door 6 kg. Five receptacles in fridge.ao_config.json: top, middle_top, middle, middle_bottom, and bottom (frl_apartment_refrigerator suffix); the candidates file places bottom and middle_bottom behind the bottom door, which is to be confirmed in the simulator. The asset has no power, temperature, light, or door-alarm state. ReplicaCAD has no WordNet synsets, so source_taxonomy repeats the asset category as both category_id and synset_id. Joint limit stands in for closed; no latch, seal, or friction detent is modelled. The Atlas concept link is a curator grouping only, and the simulator asset does not establish physical product behaviour or compatibility with a robot setup.

external_objects.name_ja: ReplicaCAD frl_apartment_rug_02 リビングのラグ
external_objects.notes: ReplicaCAD object with bounding-box collision (use_bounding_box_for_collision), config mass 12 kg, mesh bounds about 279 x 2 x 251 cm. ReplicaCAD has no WordNet synsets, so source_taxonomy repeats the category. The Atlas concept link object_textile is a curator grouping only.

Rigid ReplicaCAD object, config mass 1.0 kg, mesh bounds about 10 x 13 x 18 cm. In apt_0 it is DYNAMIC on the high office shelf above frl_apartment_table_01, its centre 1.76 m above the floor. external_objects.name_ja: ReplicaCAD frl_apartment_cloth_03 掛けてある衣類（ジャケットと推定）
external_objects.notes: Rigid ReplicaCAD object (convex-decomposition collision), config mass 1.3 kg, mesh bounds about 53 x 79 x 13 cm. identity_note: the dataset calls the four entry garments only cloth_01 to cloth_04; from mesh bounds and its place on the entry hooks this one is inferred to be a hip-length jacket, not confirmed from a label. In apt_0 it is STATIC on the entry hooks, its centre 1.20 m above the floor beside cloth_01 and cloth_02. The garment is a single rigid shape: it has no cloth simulation and no modelled hanging loop. Not YCB-derived. ReplicaCAD has no WordNet synsets, so source_taxonomy repeats the category. The Atlas concept link object_clothing is a curator grouping only.

external_objects.name_ja: ReplicaCAD chestOfDrawers_01 6段引き出しのチェスト
external_objects.notes: Articulated ReplicaCAD URDF with six prismatic joints: drawer_topL, drawer_topR, drawer_midL, drawer_midR, drawer_botL, drawer_botR, each with its own receptacle (receptacle_aabb_drawer_<joint>frl_apartment_chest_of_drawers) and a top-surface receptacle. Placed fixed-base in all 90 furnished scenes; in apt_0 it stands in the entryway. The two top drawers' receptacles are shallower than the four below them. The joint limit stands in for closed; there is no latch. Not YCB-derived. ReplicaCAD has no WordNet synsets, so source_taxonomy repeats the category. The Atlas concept link object_furniture is a curator grouping only.

external_objects.name_ja: ReplicaCAD door2 玄関の開き戸
external_objects.notes: Articulated ReplicaCAD URDF with one revolute joint, root_rotation. It is the only door placed in all 90 furnished scenes; in apt_0 it stands fixed-base at the entryway (z about -2.65 m) beside the shoe rack and entry hooks and serves as the entry door. door1, door3, and doubledoor exist in the dataset but are never placed. The joint limit stands in for closed; there is no latch. The door has no closer, handle state, or lock. Not YCB-derived. ReplicaCAD has no WordNet synsets, so source_taxonomy repeats the category. The Atlas concept link object_home_fixture is a curator grouping only.

tasks.name_en: Slide the sideboard's right sliding door along its track until it is fully shut
tasks.name_ja: サイドボードの右の引き戸をレールに沿って端まで閉め切る
instruction_variants: The right sliding door of the sideboard was left open; slide it all the way shut.
Push the sideboard's right door along its track until it stops in the closed position, and leave the left door where it is.
サイドボードの右側の引き戸が開いたままです。止まるところまでスライドさせて閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object, one goal predicate change (right_slide open -> closed), one uninterrupted lateral push. closed(replicacad_object_cabinet, left_slide) holds at start and end, so it is a preserved constraint, not a goal change; clear(rcad_resource_cabinet_door_track) is a setup precondition. ReplicaCAD mapping: closed(..., right_slide) <-> prismatic joint right_slide within 0.01 m of 0, its upper limit (range -0.76 to 0 m); open <-> right_slide at -0.40 +/- 0.02 m at start. Joint limit stands in for closed; no latch or soft-close is modelled. No active task closes a prismatic sliding cabinet door; task_thor_r2_bathroom_close_left_open_items closes four hinged or drawer openables in a bathroom, while this task is one sliding door whose open direction runs behind the other door. task_thor_r2_fridge_door_ajar_shut has the same single closed() goal shape but swings a sealed hinged appliance door; this door translates on a track and must not disturb its neighbour. Physical collection uses a real sliding-door sideboard of similar size (about 0.8 m of travel).

tasks.name_en: Close the swung-open glass-window cupboard door without touching the cups on the shelf behind it
tasks.name_ja: 開いたままのガラス窓付き戸棚の扉を、奥の棚のカップに触れずに閉める
instruction_variants: A glass-window cupboard door has been left swung open; close it without touching the cups on the shelf.
Shut the open glass door on the cup cupboard, keeping clear of the two cups behind it.
開いたままのガラス扉を閉めてください。中の棚にあるカップには触れないように。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object, one goal predicate change (doorWindow_1R_hinge open -> closed), one uninterrupted swing. The other glass door and both cups are preserved constraints: the cups start and end on rcad_resource_cupboard_shelf_left_middle (receptacle_aabb_shelf_left_middle_kitchenCupboard_01) and must not be touched, so they are not goal changes. ReplicaCAD mapping: closed(..., doorWindow_1R_hinge) <-> the hinge within 0.02 rad of 0 (range 0 to 2.3 rad); open <-> 1.2 +/- 0.1 rad at start. That doorWindow_1L/1R cover the shelf_left_* column is inferred from hinge positions in the URDF and is a planning condition. Joint limit stands in for closed; no latch or magnetic catch. The cups are ReplicaCAD frl_apartment_cup_01 and frl_apartment_cup_02 (0.5 and 0.6 kg in their configs), which are planning resources here. Differs from task_thor_r2_fridge_door_ajar_shut: that task shuts a sealed appliance door; this one is a glazed door with objects close behind it and a no-contact constraint. Physical collection uses a cupboard with acrylic or filmed glazing and unbreakable cup surrogates.

tasks.name_en: Open only the middle-bottom counter drawer, lay the frying pan flat in it, and leave all three middle drawers shut
tasks.name_ja: カウンター中央列の一番下の引き出しだけを開けてフライパンを平らに入れ、中央列の3段すべてを閉めた状態にする
instruction_variants: Put the frying pan away in the bottom drawer of the middle stack; don't open the two drawers above it, and close the bottom one after.
Lay the pan flat in the middle-bottom drawer of the counter and shut it, leaving the other middle drawers closed.
フライパンをカウンター中央の一番下の引き出しに平らに入れて閉めてください。上の2段は開けないでください。
tasks.notes: Compound: two objects in one sitting, with one net placement (the pan from the worktop into drawer2_bottom, lying flat) and a transient articulation that is reversed (middle_slide_bottom opened, then closed). closed on middle_slide_top and middle_slide_middle holds throughout; they are preserved constraints that the task makes demanding by requiring the lowest drawer to be opened without dragging the two above it. ReplicaCAD mapping: closed(..., <joint>) <-> that prismatic joint within 0.005 m of 0 (range 0 to 0.5 m); inside(pan, drawer) <-> the pan's centre of mass lies in receptacle_aabb_drawer_middle_bottom_frl_apartment_kitchen_counter (link drawer2_bottom). The pan is ReplicaCAD frl_apartment_pan_01 (1 kg; mesh bounds about 18 x 32 x 11 cm with handle), a planning resource; the functional YCB equivalent 027 skillet is not in ai-habitat/ycb, so no YCB object is used. The drawer receptacle is about 52 x 52 cm in plan and 14 cm tall (read as half-extents from the ao_config). Differs from task_thor_r1_dresser_store_folded_cloth (one cloth into a dresser's top drawer): here the drawer is the lowest of three stacked drawers and the two above must never open. Physical collection uses a real counter with a three-drawer stack and a 1 kg frying pan.

tasks.name_en: Lay the YCB fork, spoon, and knife flat in the counter's left-top drawer, knife blade to the back, and close the drawer
tasks.name_ja: YCBのフォーク・スプーン・ナイフをカウンター左上の引き出しに平らに入れ、ナイフの刃を奥に向けて引き出しを閉める
instruction_variants: Put the fork, spoon, and knife from the counter into the top-left drawer, lying flat, with the knife's blade toward the back, then shut the drawer.
Stow the three pieces of cutlery flat in the left top drawer and close it; the knife handle faces you.
カウンターの上のフォーク、スプーン、ナイフを左上の引き出しに寝かせて入れ、ナイフは刃を奥に向けてから引き出しを閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: three objects moved into one drawer in one sitting, with a knife orientation goal and a transient articulation that is reversed (left_slide_top opened, then closed); four goal changes (three placements plus the knife heading), with lying_flat as the placement standard and left_slide_bottom preserved closed. ReplicaCAD mapping: closed(..., left_slide_top) <-> the joint within 0.005 m of 0 (range 0 to 0.5 m); inside(x, drawer) <-> x's centre of mass lies in receptacle_aabb_drawer_left_top_frl_apartment_kitchen_counter (link drawer1_top). The cutlery are the atlas YCB objects ycb_030_fork, ycb_031_spoon, and ycb_032_knife, all present in the ai-habitat/ycb dataset Habitat uses for clutter, so the same objects work in simulation and physically. Safety: the knife is the blunt YCB table knife or an edge-guarded surrogate, and its handle faces the drawer front so the next hand in finds the handle. Differs from task_gso_r2_can_opener_stow_in_drawer_slot (one tool into a marked organizer slot) and task_gso_r4_dish_drainer_load_plates_cups_cutlery (cutlery handles-down in a drainer caddy): here three pieces lie loose and flat in a plain drawer that must end closed.

tasks.name_en: Take the small bowl from the counter's right-top drawer to the dining-table place in front of a chair and close the drawer
tasks.name_ja: カウンター右上の引き出しから小鉢を取り出して食卓の椅子の前の席に置き、引き出しを閉める
instruction_variants: Get the small bowl out of the top-right drawer and put it on the dining table in front of a chair, then close the drawer.
Set a bowl at the dining table: take it from the right top drawer, mouth up, and don't leave the drawer open.
右上の引き出しから小鉢を出して、食卓の椅子の前に口を上にして置いてください。引き出しは閉めておいてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: two objects, one destination, one sitting: the bowl moves from drawer3 to the table place (on_top_of and upright describe that placement), and the drawer is opened then closed again, so closed(..., right_slide_top) holds at both ends as a preserved end state. The carry crosses the open-plan apartment from the kitchen to the dining area, but it is one trip to one destination, so it is not a workflow. Source: follows the bowl-from-drawer stage of the Habitat 2.0 Home Assistant Benchmark SetTable task (Szot et al., 2021), which also fetches a fruit from the fridge; this task stops at the bowl and adds that the drawer ends closed and the bowl sits at a chair's place. ReplicaCAD mapping: inside <-> the bowl's centre of mass in receptacle_aabb_drawer_right_top_frl_apartment_kitchen_counter (link drawer3); closed <-> right_slide_top within 0.005 m of 0; the place zone is a 30 x 30 cm area of frl_apartment_table_02 centred in front of one frl_apartment_chair_05. The bowl is ReplicaCAD frl_apartment_bowl_06 (1.3 kg in its config; mesh about 16 cm across and 7.4 cm tall), a planning resource. The reverse flow, clearing a table into the sink and a cabinet, is task_thor_r2_dining_table_clear_to_sink_and_cabinet. Physical collection uses a counter drawer, a dining table about 5 m away, and a melamine bowl surrogate.

tasks.name_en: Stand the three cups on the glass-door cupboard shelf with every handle turned to the right, then close both glass doors
tasks.name_ja: 3つのカップをガラス扉の戸棚の棚に取っ手をすべて右に向けて立てて置き、ガラス扉を両方閉める
instruction_variants: Put the three cups on the middle shelf behind the glass doors, upright, all handles pointing right, and close the doors.
Line the cups up in the glass cupboard with their handles facing the same way, to the right, then shut both glass doors.
カップ3つをガラス扉の中段の棚に立てて並べ、取っ手をすべて右に向けてから、ガラス扉を両方閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: three cups placed on one shelf in one sitting, each with a heading goal, plus two glass doors opened and closed again; the goal changes are the three placements and three handle headings (upright is the placement standard), and both doors' closed state is a preserved end state. The heading reference rcad_resource_cupboard_left_column_right_wall is the right-hand side wall of the shelf as seen from the front; 'handle toward it' means each handle's direction is within 20 degrees of pointing at that wall. ReplicaCAD mapping: on_top_of <-> each cup's centre of mass in receptacle_aabb_shelf_left_middle_kitchenCupboard_01; closed <-> doorWindow_1L_hinge and doorWindow_1R_hinge within 0.02 rad of 0 (ranges -2.3 to 0 and 0 to 2.3 rad); the door-to-column mapping and which body-frame side a viewer sees as right are inferred from the URDF and are planning conditions. The cups are ReplicaCAD frl_apartment_cup_01, _02, and _03 (0.5 to 0.6 kg in their configs); their mesh bounds are 2 to 4 cm wider on one horizontal axis than the other, consistent with a handle, which is to be confirmed on the render. cup_05 is left out because it is placed only in apt_1 and apt_3. Differs from task_gso_r2_mug_hang_on_cup_hook (one mug hung by its handle): here cups stand in a row behind glazed doors with a shared heading. Physical collection uses unbreakable handled cups and a cupboard with acrylic or filmed glazing.

tasks.name_en: Put the apple, orange, and pear behind the fridge's bottom door without ever opening the top door
tasks.name_ja: 冷蔵庫の上の扉を一度も開けずに、りんご・オレンジ・洋梨を下の扉の中にしまう
instruction_variants: Put the apple, the orange, and the pear in the bottom section of the fridge and close it; don't open the top door at all.
Store the three pieces of fruit behind the lower fridge door, leaving the upper door shut the whole time.
りんご、オレンジ、洋梨を冷蔵庫の下の段にしまって扉を閉めてください。上の扉は一度も開けないでください。
tasks.notes: Compound: three objects moved into one compartment in one sitting, plus one door opened and closed again; the goal changes are the three placements. closed on bottom_door_hinge and top_door_hinge holds at both ends, so they are preserved end states, and the top door has a further trajectory constraint (it stays shut throughout), scored from the joint log. ReplicaCAD mapping: inside <-> each fruit's centre of mass in receptacle_aabb_bottomfrl_apartment_refrigerator; closed <-> the hinge within 0.02 rad of 0 (bottom_door_hinge range 0 to 2.5 rad, top_door_hinge 0 to 2.3 rad). That the bottom receptacle sits behind the bottom door comes from the candidates file and is a planning condition. The fruit are the atlas YCB plastic replicas ycb_013_apple, ycb_017_orange, and ycb_016_pear, all present in ai-habitat/ycb. ReplicaCAD's fridge has no power, light, or temperature state, so refrigerated is not a goal and no powered state is changed; a physical trial uses a real refrigerator running normally. Differs from task_ycb_round4_apple (apple and pear kept apart in a produce drawer of a generic fridge) and task_thor_r2_lettuce_fridge_shelf_door_closed (one door, one item): here three fruits go through the lower door of a two-door unit while the upper door must never open. task_thor_r1_safe_store_keychain_card shares only the put-inside-and-close shape, with a single-door safe.

tasks.name_en: Stand the fallen shoe_04 sole-down back on the lower tier of the entry shoe rack, toe to the back
tasks.name_ja: 玄関の靴棚から落ちて横倒しになったshoe_04を起こし、下段に靴底を下、つま先を奥にして戻す
instruction_variants: The shoe on the floor by the rack fell off the bottom shelf. Stand it back up on the bottom shelf, sole down and toe to the wall.
Put shoe_04 back where it was on the lower tier of the shoe rack, the right way up.
靴棚の下の段から落ちて床で横になっている靴を、靴底を下にしてつま先を奥に向け、下の段に戻してください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change, from the floor onto the lower rack tier, in one grasp-lift-orient-place sequence. sole_down and toe_toward_back are pose qualifiers of that placement. Starting pose: shoe_04 lies on its side on the entry floor within 40 cm of the rack front, as if knocked off. In apt_0 shoe_04 is the only shoe on the lower tier (about 16 cm above the floor) and shoe_01 to shoe_03 stand on the upper tier, so the free slot is known. sole_down means the sole plane is within 10 degrees of the tier surface; toe_toward_back means the heel-to-toe axis points at the wall within 20 degrees. Mesh axes: ReplicaCAD labels neither sole nor toe, so the sole and toe directions are read from the apt_0 resting pose (planning condition). Related active tasks: task_gso_r1_tennis_shoe_rack_toe_in racks a tennis shoe toe-in with its laces tucked, starting upright, and task_gso_r4_loose_shoes_match_three_pairs_rack sorts six loose shoes into pairs; this task instead recovers one fallen single shoe back into its known tier slot, with no laces and no pairing, among shoes that must stay put.

tasks.name_en: Stand the closed umbrella handle-up in the entry corner beside door2, clear of the door's swing
tasks.name_ja: 閉じた長傘を、柄を上にして玄関ドア（door2）の開閉範囲にかからない角に立てかける
instruction_variants: The umbrella fell across the doorway. Stand it up in the corner, handle on top, where the door can't hit it.
Lean the umbrella in the entry corner so the door swings freely.
床に倒れている傘を、柄を上にして玄関の角に立てかけてください。ドアを開けてもぶつからない場所にしてください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change, from lying across the floor to leaning in the corner, in one pick-orient-place sequence; handle_up and outside_swing_arc are qualifiers of where and how it stands. closed(replicacad_object_door2, root_rotation) holds at the start and the end and is a preserved condition, not a goal change; the robot does not touch door2. Starting pose: the umbrella lies inside door2's swing arc, as if it slid off the rack. rcad_resource_entry_corner_beside_door2 is the 90-degree wall corner on door2's hinge side of the entry wall, next to the rack. outside_swing_arc means no part of the umbrella is inside the floor arc swept by door2's leaf from its closed limit to its open limit, with 5 cm clearance; in simulation door2's root_rotation is swept once after the episode to confirm no contact, and the physical setup marks the arc with floor tape. leaning_in means the tip rests on the floor within 15 cm of both walls and the shaft leans 5 to 20 degrees from vertical against the wall. No active task stores an umbrella or keeps an item clear of a door swing.

tasks.name_en: Fold the flipped-over corner of the living-room rug back down so the rug lies flat, without moving the coffee table on it
tasks.name_ja: リビングのラグのめくれ返った角を戻して平らにする。ラグに載っているコーヒーテーブルは動かさない
instruction_variants: One corner of the rug has flipped over. Fold it back down flat; leave the coffee table where it is.
Someone could trip on that rug corner. Flatten it so the whole rug lies on the floor.
ラグの角が1か所めくれて裏返っています。コーヒーテーブルは動かさずに、角を戻して平らにしてください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object, one goal change (the flipped corner lies flat again), made in place by one grasp-fold-press motion; the rug is not moved. corner_at_mark is the tolerance of that same change, and standing_on(rcad_resource_coffee_table_03, rug) holds at the start and the end, so it is a preserved condition. Starting state: the corner of rug_02 nearest the sofa is folded back on itself about 25 cm along each edge (a triangle of the underside showing), outside the coffee table's legs, so the table's weight pins the rest of the rug. flat means every point along the 25 cm edges is within 1 cm of the floor (rug_02 is about 2 cm thick) and no crease is left that rises more than 1 cm; corner_at_mark means the corner vertex is within 3 cm of its tape mark. ReplicaCAD marks rug_02 STATIC with bounding-box collision, so simulation needs a cloth or deformable rug model set DYNAMIC in its place (planning condition). No active task handles a rug or another floor textile trip hazard.

tasks.name_en: Fetch the camera down from the high office shelf and set it upright on the desk mat, lens facing the front edge
tasks.name_ja: オフィスの高い棚からカメラを下ろし、机のマットの上にレンズを手前に向けてまっすぐ置く
instruction_variants: Bring the camera down from the top shelf and put it on the desk mat, standing on its base with the lens toward me.
Get the camera off the high shelf for me and leave it on the mat.
机の上の高い棚にあるカメラを下ろして、レンズを手前に向けて机のマットの上に置いてください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change, from the high shelf to the desk mat, in one reach-grasp-lower-place sequence; upright and lens_toward_front are pose qualifiers of the placement. switched_off holds at the start and the end and is preserved. The shelf is the high office shelf above frl_apartment_table_01; in apt_0 the camera's centre is 1.76 m above the floor, so its base rests about 1.70 m up, above most people's shoulder height, which is why a person asks for it. frl_apartment_setupbox sits on the lower shelf below (1.05 m) and must not be touched. upright means resting on its base plate within 10 degrees of level; lens_toward_front means the lens axis points at the desk's front edge within 20 degrees. The desk mat is a 40 x 30 cm mat centred on the front half of the desk top. Powered-device rule: the physical camera has its battery removed (or is a weighted dummy of the same 10 x 13 x 18 cm size and 1 kg), matching the unpowered mesh. No active task fetches an item down from an overhead shelf to a desk.

tasks.name_en: Hang the fallen jacket (ReplicaCAD cloth_03, inferred) back on its entry hook by its collar loop, hem clear of the floor
tasks.name_ja: 床に落ちたジャケット（ReplicaCAD cloth_03、推定）を、襟のループで玄関の元のフックに掛け直し、裾を床から離す
instruction_variants: The jacket fell off the hook by the door. Hang it back up on its hook by the little loop inside the collar.
Put the jacket back on the empty hook; the bottom shouldn't touch the floor.
玄関のフックから落ちたジャケットを、襟の内側のループで元のフックに掛け直してください。裾が床につかないようにしてください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change, from the floor to hanging on its hook, in one grasp-lift-hook motion; loop_on_hook and clear_of_floor say how it hangs. Identity: ReplicaCAD names the four entry garments only cloth_01 to cloth_04; cloth_03 (53 x 79 x 13 cm, 1.3 kg) is inferred to be a hip-length jacket from its size and its place on the entry hooks, so the task says jacket with that caveat. rcad_resource_entry_wall_hook_3 is the hook where cloth_03 hangs in apt_0 (about 1.6 m above the floor), between the hooks holding cloth_01 and cloth_02. loop_on_hook means the hook passes through the collar hanging loop, not a sleeve or the hood; clear_of_floor means the hem is at least 50 cm above the floor. The two neighbouring garments stay on their hooks (preserved). In apt_0 cloth_01 to cloth_03 are STATIC rigid meshes, so simulation needs cloth_03 set DYNAMIC as a cloth model with a loop (planning condition). Related active task: task_gso_r1_hat_hang_on_hook hangs a rigid brimmed hat on an entry hook by its crown; this task rehangs a deformable jacket that fell, by a small collar loop, next to garments that must stay put.

tasks.name_en: Put both TV remotes from the TV stand into the top-left drawer of the hall chest of drawers and close that drawer
tasks.name_ja: テレビ台のリモコン2つを、玄関のチェストの左上の引き出しに入れて、その引き出しを閉める
instruction_variants: Take both remotes off the TV stand and put them in the top-left drawer of the chest by the front door, then shut the drawer.
Remotes go in the hall chest, top left drawer. Leave the other drawers alone.
テレビ台のリモコン2つを玄関のチェストの左上の引き出しにしまって、引き出しを閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: two items and two goal changes (each remote inside drawer_topL), plus a transient articulation that must be reversed (open drawer_topL, then close it), in one carry from the living area to the entryway. closed(drawer_topL) holds at the start and the end and is a preserved end state; the other five drawers (drawer_topR, drawer_midL, drawer_midR, drawer_botL, drawer_botR) must stay closed throughout and are preserved constraints. inside(remote, chest, drawer_topL) means the remote lies wholly inside the receptacle receptacle_aabb_drawer_topLfrl_apartment_chest_of_drawers, flat, buttons up. closed means the drawer_topL prismatic joint is within 1 cm of its lower (flush) limit; the joint limit stands in for closed and there is no latch. The remotes are the two frl_apartment_remote-control_01 instances on frl_apartment_tvstand in apt_0 (5 x 1 x 18 cm, 0.1 kg each); in physical collection the batteries are removed. The TV stand and the chest are about 10 m apart in apt_0, so the carry crosses the apartment. Related active task: task_thor_r2_remote_cushions_into_basket fishes one remote out of sofa cushions into an open basket; task_thor_r1_safe_store_keychain_card puts two small items into a hinged bedroom safe beside them, and task_thor_r2_box_pack_cd_cases_close_flaps packs items from the same kind of TV stand into a flap box; this task stores two remotes in one named drawer of a six-drawer chest in another room and closes only that drawer while the other five stay shut.

tasks.name_en: Put the storage box inside the sliding-door cabinet behind its left door and slide the left door shut
tasks.name_ja: 収納ボックスを引き戸キャビネットの左側の扉の奥にしまい、左の引き戸を閉める
instruction_variants: Put the storage box away in the low cabinet, on the left side, and slide the left door closed.
Box goes behind the left sliding door of the cabinet. Don't leave the door open.
床にある収納ボックスを低いキャビネットの左側の引き戸の奥にしまって、左の引き戸を閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: one item with two goal changes (inside the cabinet, and specifically in the left half behind left_slide) plus a transient articulation that must be reversed (left_slide opened, then shut). closed(left_slide) and closed(right_slide) hold at the start and the end and are preserved end states; right_slide is never moved. The cabinet is the ReplicaCAD cabinet URDF (replicacad_object_cabinet) with two prismatic sliding doors, left_slide and right_slide, and one interior receptacle receptacle_aabb_interiorfrl_apartment_cabinet about 152 x 50 x 34 cm. behind_door means the whole box is inside the half of that receptacle covered by the left door when left_slide is at its closed limit. left_slide is prismatic with limits 0 to 0.8 m and is closed at 0, its lower limit; closed means within 0.01 m of 0, and right_slide (limits -0.76 to 0 m) likewise stays within 0.01 m of 0. The joint limit stands in for closed and there is no latch. The box is 34 cm wide, so left_slide must be opened at least 0.40 m to pass it. The box (frl_apartment_box, 34 x 27 x 17 cm, 3.1 kg) goes in upright with its 17 cm side front to back, since the interior is only 34 cm deep. The cabinet's position changes between ReplicaCAD layouts; in apt_0 it stands in the dining area. No active task uses a prismatic sliding cabinet door.

tasks.name_en: Hold door2 fully open while a person carrying the storage box walks through, then close it once they are clear
tasks.name_ja: 収納ボックスを抱えた人が通り抜ける間、door2を全開で押さえ、通り抜けたらドアを閉める
instruction_variants: I've got my hands full with this box. Hold the door open for me, and shut it once I'm through.
Open door2 all the way, keep it there until the person with the box is past, then close it gently.
箱を抱えていて手がふさがっているので、通り抜けるまでドアを全開で押さえて、通ったら閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Compound: two goal changes in one sitting at one doorway, in a fixed order. held_open_until_clear is an episode predicate: door2's root_rotation is at least 80 degrees from its closed limit from the moment the person reaches the threshold until their trailing foot is 1 m past it, with no contact between the door leaf and the person or the box. The person's move to the far side is the second change, enabled by the robot. closed(root_rotation) holds at the start and the end, so it is a preserved end state bookending the transient open hold, not a net change; the anchor appears in the goal through both predicates. held_by(box, person) is preserved: the robot never touches the box. Order constraint: the door must not start closing until the person is at least 1 m past the threshold and has said they are clear or is seen clear by the camera. Robot position: on the hinge side of the leaf, outside the 90 cm passage, so it never stands in the person's path. closed means root_rotation within 0.05 rad (about 3 degrees) of its lower limit; the joint limit stands in for closed and door2 has no latch or closer, so on the physical door closed also means the latch has engaged. The box is frl_apartment_box (34 x 27 x 17 cm, 3.1 kg), carried in both arms. Physical collection uses a real hinged door with any closer disconnected. Intent: intent_set_device_state, because the robot's own job is to leave the door open for the passage and then closed. Related tasks: task_thor_r2_bathroom_close_left_open_items and task_thor_r3_leave_house_check_doors_taps_light close doors that were left open with no one present, and task_rcad_r1_softball_from_hall_chest_handover_hold_entry_door sees a departing person out through door2 after handing them a ball, as the last stage of a workflow; this task is the door job on its own, for a person whose hands are full with a 3.1 kg box so they cannot touch the door, with the robot kept out of the passage.

tasks.name_en: Take the handbag down from the high entry shelf and hand it, handles first, to the person seated on the sofa
tasks.name_ja: 玄関の高い棚からハンドバッグを下ろし、ソファに座っている人に持ち手を向けて手渡す
instruction_variants: Could you bring me my handbag from the shelf by the door? Hand it to me by the handles.
Fetch the handbag off the top entry shelf and pass it to the person on the sofa.
玄関の上の棚にあるハンドバッグを取ってきて、ソファに座っている私に持ち手を向けて渡してください。
tasks.notes: Atomic: one object and one goal change (held_by the seated person) in one fetch-carry-offer-release sequence; handles_toward is a pose qualifier of the offer. It stays atomic even though the carry is long: there is one object, one destination, and no checkpoint. held_by means the person holds the bag alone after release and it does not drop for 5 s; handles_toward means both handles stand up on the side nearest the person's free hand, within 30 degrees. The bag (frl_apartment_handbag, 32 x 40 x 18 cm, config mass 3 kg) starts on the high entry shelf, its centre 1.87 m above the floor in apt_0, and the sofa (frl_apartment_sofa) is in the living area about 10 m away. The offer is made at the seated person's hand height, 55 to 85 cm above the floor, within 40 cm of their free hand. Because the bag is heavy, the robot releases only after the person's grip is detected and the gripper's measured load has dropped by at least half, so the person is carrying the weight. The physical bag is loaded to no more than 3 kg with soft items. Related active tasks: task_gso_r3_bootie_handover_seated_person hands a light bootie to a person on an entryway bench from a rack beside them, and task_gso_r4_tumbler_water_handover_seated_person hands an upright tumbler of water to a person in an armchair; this task fetches a 3 kg bag down from head height, carries it across the apartment, offers it by its handles, and checks the weight transfer before release.

tasks.name_en: Unpack the grocery basket cold items first: pitcher and potted meat can to the fridge's upper compartment, apple and plum to the lower compartment, cracker box and soup can to the left solid-door cupboard shelf, every door shut
tasks.name_ja: 買い物かごを冷たい物から片付ける：ピッチャーとポテッドミート缶は冷蔵庫の上の室、リンゴとプラムは下の室、クラッカーの箱とスープ缶は左の扉付き戸棚の棚へ入れ、扉はすべて閉める
instruction_variants: Put the shopping in the basket away, cold things first: the pitcher and the potted meat can go in the top part of the fridge, the apple and plum in the bottom part, and the crackers and soup on the shelf behind the left cupboard doors. Keep only one fridge door open at a time and shut everything when you're done.
Unpack the grocery basket into the fridge and the left cupboard, chilled items within three minutes, and leave the basket empty with all doors closed.
かごの中の買い物をしまってください。冷たい物を先に：ピッチャーとポテッドミート缶は冷蔵庫の上の室、リンゴとプラムは下の室へ。クラッカーとスープ缶は左側の扉付き戸棚の棚へ。冷蔵庫の扉は一度に一枚だけ開け、最後に全部閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: each basket item is in its storage zone, the basket is empty, and the fridge's two doors and the left solid cupboard doors are shut. Labelled workflow: three destinations behind three separate closures, done as three stages with checkpoints. Stage 1 (upper compartment, top_door_hinge) and stage 2 (lower compartment, bottom_door_hinge) must both be finished within 3 minutes of the start, and the top door must be closed before the bottom door is opened; stage 3 (cupboard shelf behind doorWhole_1L/1R) comes last. Closures: all four joints start closed and must end closed; they are opened and closed during the task but their end state equals the start, so they are preserved constraints checked in the success criteria and not counted as goal changes. The goal changes are the six placements and the empty basket. ReplicaCAD mapping: fridge.urdf joints top_door_hinge and bottom_door_hinge (revolute), a revolute joint counts as closed within 0.02 rad of its closed limit (0); the joint limit stands in for closed and there is no latch or seal. rcad_resource_fridge_top_compartment covers the fridge receptacles receptacle_aabb_topfrl_apartment_refrigerator and receptacle_aabb_middle_topfrl_apartment_refrigerator; rcad_resource_fridge_bottom_compartment covers receptacle_aabb_bottomfrl_apartment_refrigerator and receptacle_aabb_middle_bottomfrl_apartment_refrigerator. kitchenCupboard_01 has 12 shelf receptacles, and which of them sits behind doorWhole_1L/1R is read from receptacle positions, not from a label in the URDF; the setup confirms it (planning condition cupboard_shelf_behind_doorwhole_1_confirmed_by_position). The basket is the ReplicaCAD object config frl_apartment_basket used as a planning resource; its identity as a grocery basket is inferred from its placement in the kitchen. Hygiene: the chilled items are non-food surrogates. ycb_019_pitcher_base is empty and carries a KEEP REFRIGERATED card; ycb_010_potted_meat_can is a sealed can used only as a chilled-item shape and never opened or eaten; the YCB apple and plum are plastic. The cracker box and soup can stay sealed. Follows the Habitat 2.0 HAB PrepareGroceries task (Szot et al., 2021), which moves groceries between the counter and an already-open fridge; here both fridge doors start closed and a cupboard is added. Cross-links: all six items are atlas YCB objects present in ai-habitat/ycb, referenced and not redefined. Similar to task_gso_r4_fondant_groceries_by_temperature_zone (grocery bag by temperature zone with a freezer drawer and a pantry); this task differs by the two-door fridge whose upper and lower compartments are separate closures, the one-door-at-a-time rule, and a hinged cupboard instead of an open pantry. Also distinct from task_ycb_round4_apple, which stores one apple in a produce drawer, and from task_rcad_r1_fruit_fridge_bottom_door_top_door_unopened, which loads three fruits through the bottom door alone while the top door stays shut; here both doors are used in sequence and a cupboard stage follows.

tasks.name_en: Tidy the apartment: return the stray mug, bowl, orange, tennis ball and marker to five different homes behind five different closures (glass cupboard door, counter drawer, fridge lower door, two hall-chest drawers), closing each before opening the next
tasks.name_ja: 部屋を片付ける：出しっぱなしのマグカップ、ボウル、オレンジ、テニスボール、マーカーを、ガラス扉の戸棚・調理台の引き出し・冷蔵庫の下の扉・玄関チェストの2つの引き出しという5つの別々の定位置へ戻し、次を開ける前に閉める
instruction_variants: Tidy up: the mug goes behind the left glass cupboard door, the bowl in the counter's right top drawer, the orange in the bottom of the fridge, and the tennis ball and marker in the hall chest's bottom-right and top-right drawers. Shut each one before you open the next.
Put the five stray items from the living room, office corner, dining table and counter back where they live, one closure open at a time.
出しっぱなしの5つを片付けてください。マグカップは左のガラス扉の戸棚、ボウルは調理台の右上の引き出し、オレンジは冷蔵庫の下の室、テニスボールとマーカーは玄関チェストの右下と右上の引き出しへ。次を開ける前に、開けた扉や引き出しを閉めてください。
tasks.notes: Goal: five YCB items are each inside a different home and every closure used is shut. Labelled workflow: five destinations in three zones of the open-plan apartment (kitchen: cupboard, counter drawer, fridge; entryway: chest of drawers), collected from four other zones (living area coffee table and floor, office desk, dining table, kitchen counter), with a checkpoint after each placement: the closure just used is closed before any other closure opens. Goal changes are the five inside() placements and the mug upright; the five closures start closed and end closed, so they are preserved constraints checked in the success criteria, not goal changes. ReplicaCAD joints: kitchenCupboard_01 doorWindow_1L_hinge and fridge bottom_door_hinge are revolute (a revolute joint counts as closed within 0.02 rad of its closed limit (0)); kitchen_counter right_slide_top (link drawer3) and chestOfDrawers_01 drawer_botR and drawer_topR are prismatic (a drawer counts as closed within 0.005 m of its closed limit (0)). Joint limits stand in for closed; there are no latches. rcad_resource_cupboard_shelf_left_middle is receptacle_aabb_shelf_left_middle_kitchenCupboard_01, the glass-door shelf also used by task_rcad_r1_cups_glass_door_shelf_handles_right; its mapping to doorWindow_1L is inferred from the URDF and confirmed in setup. Surfaces the items start on (coffee table frl_apartment_table_03, office desk frl_apartment_table_01, dining table frl_apartment_table_02) are ReplicaCAD objects used here as planning resources. Follows the Habitat 2.0 HAB TidyHouse task (Szot et al., 2021), five objects to five goal receptacles; there the receptacles are open, while here each home is behind its own door or drawer. All five items are atlas YCB objects present in ai-habitat/ycb (ycb_025_mug, ycb_024_bowl, ycb_017_orange, ycb_056_tennis_ball, ycb_040_large_marker). Similar to task_thor_r3_books_three_rooms_back_to_cube_shelf (several items from three rooms to one open shelf); this task differs by five distinct homes, each behind a separate articulation of four furniture pieces, and the one-closure-open rule. replicacad_round1 kitchen articulated furniture: seven tasks (2 atomic, 5 compound) anchored to ReplicaCAD cabinet, kitchenCupboard_01, kitchen_counter, and fridge, drafted from data/research/replicacad_candidates.json.

ObjectInstances are defined only for the four anchoring furniture assets, as replicacad_object_<asset slug>; ReplicaCAD cups, bowl, pan, dining table, shelves, and drawers are rcad_resource_* planning resources, and YCB clutter reuses atlas ycb_* objects present in ai-habitat/ycb.

Joint names, limits, link masses, and receptacle names were read from the URDF and ao_config.json files at revision 3e8c7fe5759f64bfcbc3882f9cdf6de97f82a06d on 2026-09-26. The glass-door-to-shelf-column mapping of kitchenCupboard_01 and the cup handles are inferences recorded as planning conditions.
Catalog_identity claims cite evidence_replicacad_dataset; task_suitability claims cite evidence_replicacad_task_design_round1; both are defined in the round skeleton.

Living area, entryway, and office corner: 9 proposed tasks (6 atomic, 3 compound) on the ReplicaCAD apartment (scene_replicacad_apartment). Entryway: righting the fallen shoe_04 on the rack's lower tier, leaning the umbrella in the corner clear of door2's swing, rehanging the fallen jacket (cloth_03, identity inferred) by its collar loop, storing both TV remotes in chestOfDrawers_01's drawer_topL, and holding door2 open for a person carrying the storage box. Living area: flattening a flipped corner of rug_02 and handing the handbag to a person on the sofa. Office corner: fetching camera_02 from the high shelf to the desk. Dining area: stowing the storage box behind the cabinet's left sliding door.

New ObjectInstances (9): replicacad_object_shoe_04, _umbrella, _rug_02, _camera_02, _cloth_03, _chestofdrawers_01, _door2, _handbag, _box, each with a catalog_identity claim citing evidence_replicacad_dataset. The sliding-door cabinet is replicacad_object_cabinet, defined elsewhere in this bundle; this part only references it. Resource IDs beginning rcad_resource_ are planning object requirements, not cataloged ObjectInstances; the remotes, rack, sofa, desk, shelves, hooks, and coffee table stay resources.

Articulated goals name their joints: drawer_topL of chestOfDrawers_01 (the other five drawers are preserved closed), left_slide of the cabinet (right_slide preserved), and root_rotation of door2. Closed is read as the joint at its closed limit; no latch is modelled.

Static-asset setup facts: rug_02 and cloth_03 are STATIC rigid meshes in the ReplicaCAD scenes, so their tasks declare rug_02_replaced_by_dynamic_deformable_model and cloth_03_set_dynamic_as_cloth_with_loop. The camera and remotes are unpowered in the dataset; physical collection uses a battery-less camera or dummy and battery-less remotes.

People: the door and handbag tasks use a briefed, consenting adult participant, a 0.25 m/s speed cap within 1 m, an operator at the emergency stop, and (for the handbag) release only after grip and load transfer. The robot never stands in the door passage and closes the door at no more than 0.2 rad/s.
